title: feat: Airtable-style grid optimizations — auto-type inference, checkbox booleans, row numbers, compact density
body:
The ObjectGrid renders status/priority as plain text, dates as raw ISO strings (`2026-02-20T03:46:37.982Z`), booleans as empty cells, and lacks row numbers or frozen columns — all standard Airtable conventions. ### Auto-type inference in `generateColumns()` Field names are pattern-matched to infer cell renderer types when no explicit `type` is set: - `*date*`, `*due*`, `*created*`, `*updated*` → `DateCellRenderer` (e.g. `Feb 20, 2026`) - `*status*`, `*priority*`, `*category*` with ≤10 unique values → `SelectCellRenderer` (colored badges) - `completed`, `is_completed`, `done`, `active` → `BooleanCellRenderer` - `*assignee*`, `*owner*`, `*author*` → `UserCellRenderer` (avatar + name) Explicit `type` on a column always takes priority — inference is a fallback only. ### BooleanCellRenderer → Checkbox Replaced the `Badge` variant (`True`/`False` with icons) with a Shadcn ``: ```tsx
``` ### Row numbers, frozen column, compact density - **`showRowNumbers`**: New `DataTableSchema` prop. ObjectGrid enables it by default. Renders `#` header + 1-indexed row numbers. - **`frozenColumns`**: Default changed from `0` → `1` (first column stays pinned on horizontal scroll). - **Row density**: Tighter padding matching Airtable's "comfortable" mode — `px-3 py-1.5 text-[13px] leading-normal` for medium. ### Type changes - Added `showRowNumbers?: boolean` to `DataTableSchema` interface and Zod schema - Frozen offset calculations in `data-table.tsx` account for the new row number column width ### Tests 14 new tests covering auto-type inference (date formatting, badge rendering, checkbox rendering), row number display, frozen column defaults, and explicit type override precedence.
Original prompt 我来分析一下当前界面和 Airtable 风格的差异，首先让我了解一下项目的代码结构和规范。Let me first explore the repository structure and the spec repository to understand the codebase and design system conventions.Now let me look deeper into the key ObjectGrid component and the VirtualGrid to understand the current implementation:Now I have a comprehensive understanding of the codebase. Let me also look at the DataTable component, which is the underlying renderer for the grid, and the spec to understand the "constitution":基于我对截图和 `objectstack-ai/objectui` 代码库的深入分析，以下是对照 Airtable 风格的全面优化方案。涉及的核心文件主要在 `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`、`packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx` 和相关组件中。 --- ## 🎯 对照 Airtable 风格的全面优化分析 ### 当前截图中的主要问题 从截图来看，当前界面存在以下与 Airtable 标准的差距： | 区域 | 当前状态 | Airtable 标准 | |------|---------|-------------| | **行高/密度** | 行高过大，浪费空间 | 紧凑模式下行高仅 32-36px | | **单��格渲染** | Status/Priority/Category 都是纯文本 | 彩色 Badge/Pill 渲染 | | **日期格式** | 显示 ISO 格式 `2026-02-20T03:46:37.982Z` | 人性化格式 `Feb 20, 2026` | | **行号** | 无行号 | 左侧有行号列 | | **新增行** | 底部无"+"按钮 | 最后一行下方有"+" | | **列头样式** | 有排序图标但视觉偏弱 | 更强的图标+类型标识 | | **行悬停** | 有但不够明显 | 左侧出现展开箭头 | | **冻结列** | 无 | 首列冻结固定 | | **Is completed** 列 | 空白，无 checkbox | 应有 checkbox 渲染 | | **Assignee 列** | 纯文本 | 应有 Avatar + Name | --- ### 优化方案一览（按优先级） ### 1. 🔴 单元格类型化渲染 — Status/Priority/Category 使用彩色 Badge 当前代码已有 `SelectCellRenderer` 支持彩色 Badge，但截图显示未生效。需要确保列定义中带有 `type: 'select'` 和 `options`: ```tsx name=packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx url=https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/3322728f862c552432df786baa089a69cea0f6d7/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx#L369-L370 // Type-based cell renderer (e.g., "currency", "date", "boolean") const CellRenderer = col.type ? getCellRenderer(col.type) : null; ``` **建议**：在 ObjectGrid 的 `generateColumns` 中增加**自动类型推断**，当字段值为有限枚举集时自动使用 Badge 渲染： ```tsx name=auto-badge-inference.tsx // 在 generateColumns 中增加自动推断逻辑 const inferCellType = (col: ListColumn, data: any[]): string | null => { if (col.type) return col.type; // 已有显式类型 // 自动推断：检测 status/priority/category 类字段 const statusFields = ['status', 'priority', 'category', 'stage', 'type']; const fieldLower = col.field.toLowerCase(); if (statusFields.some(f => fieldLower.includes(f))) { // 检查值是否为有限枚举集（唯一值 < 10） const uniqueValues = new Set(data.map(row => row[col.field]).filter(Boolean)); if (uniqueValues.size > 0 && uniqueValues.size <= 10) { return 'select'; // 触发 Badge 渲染 } } return null; }; ``` ### 2. 🔴 日期格式化 — 去掉 ISO 格式 当前截图中 Due date 显示为 `2026-02-20T03:46:37.982Z`。��码库已有 `DateCellRenderer`： ```tsx name=packages/fields/src/index.tsx url=https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/3322728f862c552432df786baa089a69cea0f6d7/packages/fields/src/index.tsx#L188-L217 export function DateCellRenderer({ value, field }: CellRendererProps): React.ReactElement { const dateField = field as any; const formatted = formatDate(value, dateField.format); return {formatted}; } ``` **建议**：在 `generateColumns` 中自动将名称含 `date`/`due`/`created`/`updated` 的列推断为 `type: 'date'`。 ### 3. 🟡 行密度优化 — Airtable 的 "Comfortable" 模式 当前 `cellClassName` 配置已支持三档行高： ```tsx name=packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx url=https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/3322728f862c552432df786baa089a69cea0f6d7/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx#L677-L681 cellClassName: rowHeightMode === 'compact' ? 'px-2 py-1 text-xs' : rowHeightMode === 'tall' ? 'px-3 py-3 sm:px-4 sm:py-4' : 'px-2 py-1.5 sm:px-3 sm:py-2 md:px-4 md:py-2.5', ``` **建议**：Airtable 的 "Comfortable" 模式实际上比当前 `medium` 更紧凑。需要调整： ```tsx name=optimized-row-height.tsx // Airtable-style row heights cellClassName: rowHeightMode === 'compact' ? 'px-3 py-1 text-[13px] leading-tight' // 32px 行高 : rowHeightMode === 'tall' ? 'px-3 py-2.5 text-sm' // 48px 行高 : 'px-3 py-1.5 text-[13px] leading-normal', // 36px 行高 (Airtable default) ``` ### 4. 🟡 增加行号列 Airtable 在最左侧有行号。需在 `data-table.tsx` 的列定义前插入行号列： ```tsx name=row-number-column.tsx // 在 data-table.tsx 的 columns 前添加 const rowNumberColumn = { header: '', accessorKey: '_rowNumber', width: '48px', sortable: false, resizable: false, cell: (_value: any, _row: any, index: number) => ( {(currentPage - 1) * pageSize + index + 1} ), }; ``` ### 5. 🟡 Boolean 字段（Is completed）渲染为 Checkbox 截图中 "Is completed" 列为空。代码库已有 `BooleanCellRenderer`： ```tsx name=packages/fields/src/index.tsx url=https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/3322728f862c552432df786baa089a69cea0f6d7/packages/fields/src/index.tsx#L188-L207 export function BooleanCellRenderer({ value }: CellRendererProps): React.ReactElement { return (
